note: denoise ignores the range sigma, so the bilateral filter becomes a plain Gaussian and smooths across the edge, caught by DenoiseClarityTests.edgeKept
clarity drops the mid-tone weight, so full clarity pushes highlights past 1 and shadows below 0, caught by DenoiseClarityTests.highlightsUnclipped
denoise smooths chroma at the luma sigma instead of twice it, so colour noise stays, caught by DenoiseClarityTests.chromaSmoothedAtTwiceSigma
denoise drops the alpha normalisation of chroma, so transparent neighbours dilute an edge's colour, caught by DenoiseClarityTests.transparentLendsNoColour
clarity drops its overflow guard, so an infinite component is stored, caught by DenoiseClarityTests.clarityOverflowThrows
replacement: return PixelBuffer(checkedWidth: width, height: height, storage: out)
